rounds.recommendations: When generating mutants for GPU kernels with multiple dimension-specific code paths, mutation testing frameworks should track which code paths are reachable under the fixed input configuration. Mutating unreachable branches (like the 2D path when only 3D inputs are tested) creates unkillable mutants that waste testing resources.
